card.name: Dosing interval words like alternate, week
card.fires_on: Words that set a repeating schedule, such as alternate in 'on alternate days', and week, weeks, month or daily after 'once a' or 'every 2'. Mostly in dosing schedule text.

modes.label: Alternate days
modes.description: The word alternate in a schedule of intermittent dosing.
modes.example: administration on<< alternate>> days or on three to five days each

modes.label: Interval unit
modes.description: A time unit such as week or month that ends a frequency phrase.
modes.example: 150 mg once a<< week>> (every 7 days) for

modes.label: Regularity adverb
modes.description: A word like regularly or daily describing how often something recurs.
modes.example: where for almost a year it was struck<< regularly>> until, on 17 October

card.writes: It seems to push toward words that mean steady or ongoing, such as stable and indefinitely.
card.plain: It lights up on words that say how often something repeats, like every other day or once a week.
